body:
sre-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (p99>3s), streaming stalls, 2026-04-02T09:12:36Z. Affected region: eu-west-2b. On-call: @maya
maya: Ack. switching to #incident-mode. Paging infra and networking.
devon: here. grabbing net metrics and tcpdump
alex: noticed TLS handshake durations spike + retransmits on nat-egress-2b. Also host-level CPU steal on hypervisor
liam: DNS latencies popping too; repeated re-resolves observed for same hosts. Could be packet loss causing TCP timeouts
maya: can someone run mtr/traceroute from gateway pod? devon?
devon: pasted mtr output:
```
Start: Fri Apr 02 09:14:05 2026
HOST: gw-pod-12          Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 1.|-- 10.10.1.1          0.0%    40    0.5   0.7   0.2   2.5   0.4
 2.|-- 10.10.2.1          0.0%    40    1.2   1.1   0.9   3.6   0.5
 3.|-- 172.31.4.9        18.0%    40   45.2  39.8  12.4 130.7 26.3
```
Looks like drop starting at NAT hop
alex: confirming net drops on nat-eu-west-2b pool. tcp_retransmits high. Hypervisor reports CPU steal ~25%
maya: quick mitigation idea: divert affected tenants to alternate egress pool (egress-west-2a) with canary. Also reduce streaming concurrency per-tenant to limit TLS handshake storms
liam: temporary DNS cache tweak pushed (internal resolvers TTL=20s) to reduce re-resolve pressure
ops-runner: deploy-bot: applied route change for tenant AcmeCorp -> egress-west-2a (canary=10%). change_id: route-198001
maya: monitoring canary. p99 for canary lowered from 5.2s to 1.9s after ~40s
devon: cordoning suspect NAT hosts: `kubectl annotate node nat-eu-west-2b-07 maintenance=true` then draining. Also starting replacement instances
alex: running tcpdump snippet on nat to confirm TLS SYN/ACK retransmits:
```
sudo tcpdump -n -c 200 'tcp port 443 and (tcp[tcpflags] & tcp-syn != 0)'
```
Saw many SYN retransmits
maya: good. if canary stays stable, migrate traffic in staged rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 60s burn each. rollback if p99>3s or errors spike
ops-runner: route update: stage1 -> 25% (applied)
maya: stage1 looks ok. stage2 -> 50%
liam: stage2 shows minor blips but p99 < 3s. proceeding to 100%
ops-runner: route update: AcmeCorp -> egress-west-2a (100%) change_id: route-198001-final
maya: p99 settled ~1.7s. streaming stall rate down 80%. Good.
devon: replaced 3 NAT instances in 2b, collected hypervisor logs: IO interrupts and NIC resets. Uploaded to ticket INC-2026-198001
alex: note: investigate autoscaling policy for NAT pool and consider faster replacement for host-level faults
cs-rep: notified customer: "We've rerouted traffic to alternate egress and are replacing impacted infrastructure. Expectation: service restored. We'll share a postmortem." They requested ETA; gave ~2h for full analysis
maya: follow-ups: devon -> host remediation + logs, alex -> capacity review for egress-west-2a and fallback readiness, liam -> temp DNS runbook entry, cs-rep -> customer comms
sre-bot: Incident MITIGATED. Ticket INC-2026-198001 created. Postmortem requested.
maya: timeline: detected 09:12:36Z, canary 09:15:20Z, full migration 09:22:10Z. Closing thread once follow-ups are in ticket. Thanks team :thumbsup:
